description: GPT-6 Astra takes computer use and AI creation to another level. It is much better at handling tasks across websites and software, and it can also work with 3D tools, build virtual environments, and help create and test games. What makes this really interesting is that you do not need to be an expert in tools like Blender, Unreal, Unity, or Godot to start using them in useful ways. Access is still limited for now, but Astra shows how much more capable AI agents are becoming at doing real work on your computer. What would you build with it? #GPT6 #gpt6astra #chatgpt #openai
